note: Sunday 2 Aug weekend run (day 2): no market publishes a new investor-type split over the weekend, so every market entry below is CARRIED FORWARD with its per-market asOf left at the true data date (unchanged, not restamped) — the freshest are Korea (Fri 31 Jul daily; KRX shut Sat/Sun) and the Japan/SGX weekly series (week to 24 Jul); the next Japan weekly (week to 31 Jul) publishes ~Thu 6 Aug. Every figure below was read off a source document and then independently re-verified by a second pass that re-opened each source. Corrections that pass forced: the US ICI series is MUTUAL-FUND-ONLY (ETFs excluded) so it is NOT a risk-off signal; the Singapore read was replaced with the verified weekly tracker after a stale monthly line contradicted it; the Korea read was moved off a +3.6% rally day to the latest completed session; and two BofA lines were dropped because their only source carried a self-disclaimer. Markets differ in what they disclose — proxies are badged, and what is simply not published is stated rather than filled in.
